report="R5740 independent FieldLog R5660 source and ABI review

Verdict: REQUEST_CHANGES, scoped to the frozen nine-file source proposal and the current canonical shipping UI owner. No product execution or native parity was performed.

P1 F1 — The proposal is rejected by the existing sealed UI ABI.
Afterimage FieldLogTaskGuest/main.swift:34-40,41-81 and scripts/build-task-guest.py:10-12 define/export four additional FieldLog functions and a ready function returning UInt32. vm/src/experimental/swift.rs:848-878 requires exactly five total exports (memory plus four functions), rejects unknown exports, and requires ready to have no result. In particular lines 852-853 reject the nine-export artifact before binding; lines 867-871 reject ()->i32 ready even after removing the four extras. Existing NativeSwiftFeatureBackend.swift:30-59 and guest_ui.rs expose frame/event/consume only. No final payload execution, unsupported-instruction admission, or import acceptance follows from host compilation or Node WASI success. This is a source-level contradiction, not a reproduced VM execution.

P1 F2 — Close cannot report consuming ownership, and a failed close becomes apparent success on a second call.
TaskEditorGuestRuntime declares only close() throws (TaskEditorGuestPresentation.swift:6-15). Presentation.close():75-84 sets closed=true before calling runtime.close(); if runtime.close throws, subsequent close returns immediately at line 76. The runtime remains held only by the presentation; no clean ledger or retained authority is transferred to an accountable outer owner. Constructor frame/decode rejection at lines 32-40 likewise has no typed failure/consumption result. The existing SwiftFeatureRuntime.swift:31-40,50-76,83-102 explicitly distinguishes failedOwned acquisition, validated clean ledger and retained cleanup authority. Adopt that ownership model rather than interpreting thrown close or UI-closed state as consuming success. Retention must survive presentation dismissal; do not retry consuming a retained failure.

P2 F3 — Status decoding does not enforce the application state machine or exact fields.
TaskEditorGuestPresentation.swift:140-163 binds revision and the two text values, rejects saving && saved, and requires saved when outcome=="saved". It accepts outcome=="editing" with saved=true, and outcome=="cancelled"/"closed" with saving=true if routes are empty. admitSave():86-100 does not require outcome==editing, so a terminal status with saving=true and a matching pending request can reach the host persistence callback. These are static counterexamples to the guards, not executed malformed-input controls. Synthesized Codable for status/request/completion also ignores unknown fields; JSONInputGuard is generic JSON/duplicate/limit admission, not an application key schema. Require exact admitted fields, state/outcome/navigation coherence, valid positive generation, and pending iff saving before any repository call. Preserve bounded byte/string admission and duplicate-key checks. Require completion to clear that same generation and yield a state consistent with its result.

Source observations accepted within scope:
- Save IDs are UInt64, positive monotonically increasing in the producer, checked against lastSaveID and activeSaveID by the host, and matched to pending on completion. Do not pass these through Double/JavaScript Number; retain exact 64-bit integers (or an explicitly versioned decimal-string wire encoding).
- Host completion occurs only after await save(title,responsible). Presentation cancellation closes the UI, cancels its task and blocks late guest completion using closed/Task.isCancelled/activeSaveID. Cancellation does not promise rollback of an already-started repository write; preserve the existing repository semantics.
- The existing asynchronous TaskEditor path remains; the new host-completion initializer is separate. The patch manifest contains no WorkspaceModel or WorkspaceRepository edits. Actual WorkspaceModel.addTask/WorkspaceRepository bodies were not independently requalified in this bounded source review. The accepted binding invokes the real addTask closure once per admitted generation and keeps repository validation, serialization, normalization and durability unchanged.
- TaskEditorAppleFieldsHost receives any TaskEditorPresenting through an additive public initializer. Native projection accepts fixed task.title/task.responsible IDs and copies their properties. Keep a visible variant in those consumed fields/title text, with IDs/actions/shape unchanged; a new unconsumed node does not prove a visible change.
- Original two Wasm payloads precede the status/generation extension. Approach-1 reconstruction is not a reproducible rebuild. HostIntegration versions=[] demonstrates ordinary save only. R5710 native baseline has no guest/OTA. R5750 owns fresh final-source proof; this review neither consumes nor substitutes it.

Accepted shipping Wasm ABI (required exactly, wasm32):
  memory: exported memory index 0; validated memory and table must exist.
  _initialize: () -> ()
  mixer_guest_ui_start_v3: () -> i32
  mixer_guest_ui_event_v3: (i32 byteCount) -> i32
  mixer_guest_ui_ready_v3: () -> ()
  No other exports. No arbitrary function-name/index invocation.
Start/event return a u32 offset (i32 bit pattern) of an eight-u32 little-endian MUI3 header:
  [0x3349554d,32,documentPtr,documentLength,eventPtr,1048576,0,0].
Document length is 1...1048576. Header/document/event regions must be in wasm32 memory and pairwise disjoint; header, document and event pointers stay pinned across turns. Event input is 1...1048576 bytes, within the admitted event capacity. Copy guest data into bounded host-owned values before another call; preserve existing execution/copy/turn/cancellation budgets and cumulative limit. VM consume, not a guest void callback, establishes the fourteen-zero-currents/zero-ticket/no-invariant outcome.

Concrete smaller typed contract for Root coordination (proposal, no source redesign applied):
Keep that exact five-export ABI and native frame/event/consume entry points. Define one explicitly identified TaskEditorExchangeV1 codec inside the existing bounded MUI3 document bytes:
  {schemaVersion:1, document:FeatureDocumentV3, status:TaskEditorGuestStatusV1,
   pendingSave:TaskEditorGuestSaveRequestV1?}
Every start/event returns one atomic exchange. Define a closed event enum on the existing event buffer:
  ui(GuestUIEventV3) | saveCompletion(id:UInt64,result:saved|failed(message)).
A TaskEditor-specific adapter validates the exact wrapper and nested FeatureDocumentV3, then exposes only the nested document to the native renderer. The generic FeatureDocumentV3 decoder remains strict; it does not silently accept the wrapper. Public app identity/version admission must select this codec explicitly. UI events retain their public routing/sequence checks. Completion is a distinct typed host control, never a fabricated user action or arbitrary export call. One coherent exchange binds pending ID, state and render revision and removes the need for four additional guest exports or sideband memory/header reads.
Proposed Swift ownership shape:
  @MainActor protocol TaskEditorGuestRuntime {
    func exchange() throws -> TaskEditorGuestExchangeV1
    func send(_ event: GuestUIEventV3) throws -> TaskEditorGuestExchangeV1
    func completeSave(_ completion: TaskEditorGuestSaveCompletionV1) throws -> TaskEditorGuestExchangeV1
    func consume() -> SwiftFeatureCloseOutcome
  }
Acquisition/initialization failures must return a consuming outcome with retained authority when unresolved; close caches and returns its exact outcome. Wire DTO parsing is strict and bounded. No constructor or ReviewedDevelopmentGrant grants signed OTA authority. Signed assignment/artifact verification and capability checks remain in their existing owners. This envelope contract requires producer/adapter/codec coordination and is not implemented or runtime-qualified by this review.

Alternative if Root deliberately retains sideband exports:
Require a separately named sealed FieldLog proof/profile, not relaxation of ValidatedSwiftUI or a generic-export bridge. Its exact list would be the five corrected shipping exports above plus:
  mixer_fieldlog_status_v1: () -> i32
  mixer_fieldlog_save_request_v1: () -> i32 (0 means none)
  mixer_fieldlog_save_complete_v1: (i32 byteCount) -> i32
  mixer_fieldlog_close_v1: () -> ()
Status/request return an offset to [u32LE payloadPtr,u32LE payloadLength]; copy immediately because they reuse the same scratch. Validate range/capacity/aliasing, one initialized owner, exact state/generation, and charge all calls/copies under the same budgets. Completion writes the admitted event buffer and returns MUI3. A guest close callback never replaces consuming VM cleanup. This alternative is a new coordinated contract requiring independent implementation validation, not an accepted bind under the current profile.

Smallest next actual native test, Root-owned after contract choice and R5750 final-source evidence:
Use one admitted initialized native owner with the corrected shipping ABI/typed app codec. Feed its actual exchange into TaskEditorGuestPresentation and TaskEditorAppleFieldsHost. Verify a changed consumed title/text, edit both existing fields, submit once into the actual WorkspaceModel.addTask closure, reload via the existing WorkspaceRepository to observe exactly one persisted task, and consume the owner with the exact clean ledger. An owned iOS Simulator may supply the renderer evidence under existing Accessibility/cleanup rules. Add a focused failure/cancel control proving a late completion cannot invoke a closed runtime and a retained consume failure is returned unchanged. Do not call this a whole L01-L08, signed OTA or GA pass.

No builds, product runtimes, VM, HTTP, signing, devices, children, Git/index/CI writes, product edits, or historical-hold access were performed.
